labels.0x06: Pulse output mode; RS485 protocol; Anti-theft code byte
labels.0x07: Speed loop KI; Speed loop KP
labels.0x08: Throttle closed voltage; Throttle full voltage
labels.0x0B: Brake input mode (4 = brake disabled); Motor temperature sensor type; Phase exchange; Slow-down strength; Race response; Current anti-theft (lock motor); Park mode; Motor direction reversed
labels.0x0F: Current loop start KI; Current loop mid KI
labels.0x10: Current loop max KI; Current loop start KP
labels.0x11: Current loop mid KP; Current loop max KP
labels.0x14: Motor pole pairs; Word 0x14 high byte
labels.0x1A: Throttle follow mode; ECO mode; Field weakening mode; Config bits 6-7 (word 0x1A); Speed pulses per revolution; Gear switch mode
labels.0x20: Custom code character 0; Custom code character 1
labels.0x22: Last save: year; Last save: month
labels.0x23: Last save: day; Last save: hour
labels.0x24: Last save: minute; Last save: second
labels.0x2C: Throttle release response; Word 0x2C high byte
labels.0x32: Low gear line current ratio; Mid gear line current ratio
labels.0x33: Low gear phase current ratio; Mid gear phase current ratio
labels.0x65: Application / motor type code; Word 0x65 high byte (maybe a current multiplier)
labels.0x69: Boost input pin; Cruise input pin; Side-stand input pin; Park input pin
labels.0x6A: Forward input pin; Reverse input pin; High speed input pin; Low speed input pin
labels.0x6B: Charge input pin; Anti-theft input pin; Seat input pin; Voltage switch input pin
labels.0x6E: Parameter set index; Special code character
labels.0x7C: Feature config byte 0; Feature config byte 1 (fast reverse etc.)
labels.0x84: Motor temperature limit; Motor temperature restore
labels.0x85: Controller temperature limit; Controller temperature restore
labels.0x86: CAN configuration; Word 0x86 bits 6-7; Firmware version character 0
labels.0x88: Power curve at 0 RPM (probable); Power curve at 500 RPM
labels.0x89: Power curve at 1000 RPM; Power curve at 1500 RPM
labels.0x8A: Power curve at 2000 RPM; Power curve at 2500 RPM
labels.0x8B: Power curve at 3000 RPM; Power curve at 3500 RPM
labels.0x8C: Power curve at 4000 RPM; Power curve at 4500 RPM
labels.0x8D: Power curve at 5000 RPM; Power curve at 5500 RPM
labels.0x8E: Power curve at 6000 RPM; Power curve at 6500 RPM
labels.0x8F: Power curve at 7000 RPM; Power curve at 7500 RPM
labels.0x90: Power curve at 8000 RPM; Power curve at 8500 RPM
labels.0x92: Regen curve at 0 RPM; Regen curve at 500 RPM
labels.0x93: Regen curve at 1000 RPM; Regen curve at 1500 RPM
labels.0x94: Regen curve at 2000 RPM; Regen curve at 2500 RPM
labels.0x95: Regen curve at 3000 RPM; Regen curve at 3500 RPM
labels.0x96: Regen curve at 4000 RPM; Regen curve at 4500 RPM
labels.0x97: Regen curve at 5000 RPM; Regen curve at 5500 RPM
labels.0x98: Regen curve at 6000 RPM; Regen curve at 6500 RPM
labels.0x99: Regen curve at 7000 RPM; Regen curve at 7500 RPM
labels.0x9A: Regen curve at 8000 RPM; Regen curve at 8500 RPM
labels.0x9B: Regen curve at 9000 RPM; Regen curve at 9500 RPM
labels.0x9C: Auxiliary input mode (AN); Relay output enabled; No-load mode; Low-battery limiting mode (LM); Word 0x9C bits 14-15
labels.0x9F: Voltage selection ratio; Word 0x9F high byte
labels.0xA0: Command register marker (0x88); Command register: last system command (04 = save to flash)
labels.0xAB: PIN check register (last PIN entered; temporary)
labels.0xB4: One-wire sequence byte 0; One-wire sequence byte 1
labels.0xB5: One-wire sequence byte 2; One-wire sequence byte 3
labels.0xB6: One-wire sequence byte 4; One-wire sequence byte 5
labels.0xB7: One-wire sequence byte 6; One-wire sequence byte 7
labels.0xB9: Word 0xB9 (changed with settings; not a simple checksum; app never reads it)
labels.0xBA: One-wire pulse width; One-wire pulse period
labels.0xBD: Low-SOC limit stage 1; Low-SOC limit stage 2
labels.0xBE: Low-battery current limiting method; Config bits 8-11 (word 0xBE); ECO acceleration coefficient
labels.0xC9: Exit follow speed; Reverse current ratio
labels.0xCA: Angle learn; Speed limit input pin; Repair input pin
labels.0xCB: CAN detect timing; Gear and temperature mode bits
labels.0xCC: Learn throttle; Speed limit minimum capacity
labels.0xCD: Speed limit start capacity; Speed limit by capacity
labels.0xCE: Speed limit max coefficient; Slow-down coefficient; Battery type select
labels.0xD0: One-wire data byte 0; One-wire data byte 1
labels.0xD7: Global state 1 (hall error, auto-learn, motor running flags)
labels.0xF5: Word 0xF5 low byte (scaled time?); Battery state of charge
labels.0xF6: Word 0xF6 low byte; Last modified: year
labels.0xF7: Last modified: month; Last modified: day
